reason: Withdrawn from the active receipt per #1202: the comparison cases read audit-1053/application-catalog.json, but the three discriminating cases (CodemodeCatalogSessionTest: late registration, only-loadout, discovery globals) assert literals instead of comparing the registered frozen artifact, so the whole-row claims are not reproducible from the pinned evidence (discriminator-level, weaker than #1104; row 72 codemode-models-description-gate is expressly unaffected and stays claimed). The three rows revert to their source-audit status, fail-closed per owner decision 2 (docs/wiki/pi-alignment/decisions-2026-11-04.md), pending re-anchoring through #1202's acceptance criteria. See 1202-1104-evidence-integrity.md and 1177-application-reconciliation.md.
